title: Weddings | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Picture your day at our barn wedding venue in Bridgton, Maine. Ceremony and reception on one farm. Up to 135 guests. Sundays and weekdays, May through October.
heading: The walk down the aisle. *The mountain in view.*
lede: Your guests are seated in the field, with Pleasant Mountain beyond. After the vows, the celebration continues here on our family farm in Bridgton, Maine. We host weddings for up to 135 guests on Sundays and weekdays, May through October.
hero_alt: Benches in the ceremony field and the farmhouse in evening light

steps.title: Getting ready with your wedding party
steps.body: Your dress has its own hook in the bridal room. There's a vanity with an arched mirror, and your wedding party can get ready with you. The groom's party has a separate room in the ell beside the barn.

steps.title: Your walk into the field
steps.body: Pleasant Mountain forms the view beyond the ceremony field. We made the benches from old barn floorboards. Your reception stays on the same farm, so guests won't need to drive to another venue.

steps.title: Your first meal as newlyweds
steps.body: You can take your seats by the French doors for your first meal as newlyweds. We include tables and chairs with rental. Your caterer has a prep kitchen for finishing the meal.

steps.title: A conversation that carries on outside
steps.body: The patio gives guests somewhere to sit outside the barn. We have outdoor string lights and a stone seating circle in the field.

sunday.heading: A Sunday for your wedding. *Saturday to get here.*
sunday.body: A Sunday wedding gives travelling guests the option of arriving on Saturday. We also host weekday weddings from May through October. If your plans are flexible, compare Sunday and weekday quotes from your vendors. We don't book Saturdays. [CONFIRM: wording Susan is comfortable with]

faq.q: How many guests can we invite?
faq.a: We host up to 135 guests across the venue. Seating varies between the main floor, loft and patio. Susan can help you review the dining arrangement for your guest count.
Ask Susan to walk through the indoor ceremony and reception arrangements for your guest count before you book. [CONFIRM: indoor ceremony capacity, room changeover and when the rain decision is made]
We don't book Saturdays. We host Sunday weddings and also book weekdays, May through October.
May through October. Autumn brings color to the trees beyond the ceremony field, with Pleasant Mountain in view.
We host weddings without alcohol. Guests of all ages are welcome, and there's no alcohol bill to add to your budget.
Yes. We include tables and chairs with rental. We have tables measuring 6 or 8 feet long and 5 foot rounds. The arrangement depends on your guest count and the spaces you use.

faq.q: Can we bring our own caterer?
faq.a: We provide a prep kitchen for your outside caterer, with barn doors they can close while finishing your meal. Confirm the caterer requirements with Susan before hiring anyone.

faq.q: How long do we have the barn?
faq.a: Confirm the rental hours with Susan before arranging deliveries or setting your wedding schedule. [CONFIRM: access window, setup the day before, end time]

faq.q: Can we have our ceremony outside?
faq.a: Yes. Our ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain. Your guests sit on benches made from the barn's old floorboards, and your reception can be on the same farm.

We have three accessible parking spaces in the driveway and a wooden ramp to the main floor. We also have an ADA bathroom and a paved path to the patio. Ask Susan about access to the ceremony field and other rooms.
Yes. We welcome families with children. Let Susan know if you have questions about the spaces for your youngest guests.
Contact Susan for the pricing brochure and available dates, or arrange a private tour. You can start with a season if you haven't chosen a date. [CONFIRM: deposit and booking steps]
You can reach Susan by email, call or text. [CONFIRM: Susan's reply time]

closing.heading: Walk through the barn *with your wedding in mind.*
closing.body: Come see the rooms and ceremony field with Susan. You can request pricing and ask about available dates before arranging a visit.
